## Automated Tests Required

### Stories `7-1`, `7-2`, `7-3`: Multi-Directional Melee & Ranged Combat — Logic / Integration
**Test file paths**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/MeleeSectorMathTests.cs`, `Assets/Tests/EditMode/NetworkProjectileLifecycleTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Vertical Slash (`LMB`, `2.5m`, `50 deg`, `cos >= 0.9063078`, `25 dmg`, `0.6s` CD) and Horizontal Sweep (`Keys 1/3`, `3.0m`, `90 deg` offset `+-45 deg`, `cos >= 0.7071068`, `30 dmg`, `1.2s` CD) sector boundaries and `LineOfSightMask` wall occlusion.
- `11`-tick (`0.18s`) `+-90.0 deg` yaw interpolation (`~8.1818 deg/tick`) while ignoring manual mouse `LookYaw`.
- Ranged projectile (`RMB`, `0.4s` CD, `15.0 m/s`, `15 dmg`) per-tick `SphereCast` (`r=0.15m`) and muzzle-against-wall `Linecast` guard.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit/integration tests

### Stories `8-1`, `8-2`, `8-3`: Dual Camera (`FPS`/`TPS`) & Ghost Spectator — Visual/Feel / Logic / Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/CameraControllerTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- `Key V` perspective toggle preserving `Yaw`/`Pitch` and setting `ShadowCastingMode.ShadowsOnly` in `FPS`.
- `CalculateClampedBoomDistance` clamping `hit.distance - 0.15f` to `[0.6f, 4.5f]` on `Layer 6` while ignoring `Layer 8/10`.
- `SpectatorController` Ghost Free-Roam clamping `[-22m, +22m]` and survivor cycling (`LMB`/`RMB`) when followed target dies.
**Estimated test count**: ~8 unit/integration tests

### Stories `9-1`, `9-2`, `9-3`: Match Manager & MasterClient Failover — Logic / Integration
**Test file paths**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/MatchManagerStateTests.cs`, `Assets/Tests/PlayMode/ArenaMatchSmokeTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- `Waiting -> Countdown (3s) -> Playing (180s) -> Ended (8s)` state transitions and countdown abort when `< 2` players remain.
- Last Man Standing (`AliveCount == 1`), same-tick double KO (`DRAW`), and `180s` Sudden Death `(CurrentHP DESC, Kills DESC)`.
- Deterministic lowest-`PlayerId` MasterClient election and `MatchRoster` reconciliation on host disconnect.
**Estimated test count**: ~9 unit/integration tests

### Stories `10-1..10-3` & `11-1..11-3`: HUD, Mobile Action Pad, Lobby & Keybinding Rebind UI — UI
**Test file paths**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/CombatHudPresenterTests.cs`, `Assets/Tests/EditMode/LobbyValidationTests.cs`, `Assets/Tests/EditMode/KeybindingManagerTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Billboard distance scale `clamp(d / 8.0f, 0.75f, 1.35f)`, 4-row kill feed ring buffer, `DisplayName`/`RoomCode` validation, and `ShouldShowMobilePad(mode, isTouch, isAlive)`.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Launch into Lobby, validate `DisplayName`/`RoomCode`, join a room, and transition through `Waiting -> Countdown (3s) -> Playing (180s)`.
2. Execute `LMB` Vertical Slash (`25 dmg`), `Keys 1/3` Horizontal Sweep (`30 dmg` + `90 deg` turn over `11 ticks`), and `RMB` Ranged Projectile (`15 dmg`) via both PC keys and the 7-button Mobile Action Pad.
3. Toggle `Key V` between `TPS` and `FPS` and verify `SphereCast` wall anti-clip against `Layer 6` pillars/walls.
4. Eliminate opponents until `AliveCount == 1` (verifying Ghost Free-Roam & Follow-Target spectator on eliminated client) and confirm `MatchManager` crowns the winner (including when the original MasterClient disconnects mid-match).
